## Motivation

Temporarily disable the eight-B300 DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + prefill CP + DSPARK E2E test. This change is based on main after #43935 and preserves that fix; it does not assert that the previously observed accuracy failure remains after the fix.

## Modifications

- Mark the test registration disabled so regular CI excludes it.
- Skip the unittest class so selective reruns and direct invocation also avoid launching the servers.
- Retain the test implementation and assertions for re-enablement.

## Accuracy Tests

No GPU accuracy run: this only disables test execution. Verified the real CI registry parser reports the test disabled, and executed the class AST with dependency stubs to confirm unittest skips before server setup. `git diff --check` passes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable; no inference code changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Scoped to the B300 PD/CP E2E test.
- [x] Validated registry exclusion and unittest skip behavior.
- [x] Preserved the CP fix in #43935 and the test assertions.

@@ -16,7 +16,12 @@
 from sglang.test.test_utils import try_cached_model
 
 # Initial estimate; update after the first B300 CI run.
-register_cuda_ci(est_time=1800, stage="extra-b", runner_config="8-gpu-b300")
+register_cuda_ci(
+    est_time=1800,
+    stage="extra-b",
+    runner_config="8-gpu-b300",
+    disabled="Temporarily disabled: DSV4.1 PD+CP B300 E2E.",
+)
 
 MODEL = "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash"
 
@@ -51,6 +56,8 @@
 ]
 
 
+# Also skip selective reruns, which bypass the registry's disabled marker.
+@unittest.skip("Temporarily disabled: DSV4.1 PD+CP B300 E2E")
 class TestDeepseekV41PDCPDSpark(PDDisaggregationServerBase, GSM8KMixin):
     model = MODEL
     prefill_tp_size = 4
